'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Listen brother, I've got a job for you. You know I'm pretty much the only guy who deals in all kinds of nylon. Well, I was. Lately, some competition has started popping up... I can't afford to lose my edge. And wouldn't you know it, one of my shipments is fucking delayed!

Can you go around Tarkov and bring me some stuff to sell? I really need this, brother! Don't worry, I'll pay you for the goods. Here's the list of what I need.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 29 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Hand over any [[Found in raid|Found in Raid]] items from the Facecovers category x15
* Hand over any [[Found in raid|Found in Raid]] items from the [[Headwear|Headgear]] category x15
* Hand over any [[Found in raid|Found in Raid]] items from the Headests category x15
* Hand over any [[Found in raid|Found in Raid]] items from the [[Eyewear]] category category x15
* Hand over any [[Found in raid|Found in Raid]] items from the [[Body armor|Body Armor]] category category x15
